title: Oracle call specification
statement: A call specification for a program with $m$ registers, $d$ deciders, and state set $\Lambda$ consists of a decider indexed among the $d$ choices, a virtual-input mode, an ordered list of register indices, and a state to enter after a positive answer and a state to enter after a negative answer.
